phases.name: Audit and preserve baseline
phases.evidence: 392 baseline tests; 70 source hashes match original local source, remote deployment unverified; CRYPTO_ENGINE_AUDIT.md

phases.name: Active universe, streaming discovery and candidate bridge
phases.evidence: Bounded live probe: 3729 Binance instruments, 1380 active spot pairs, 480 fresh observed in 15 seconds, two successful inference requests. Coinbase fallback directory403; stale candles rejected. Not full-ecosystem coverage.

phases.name: Python LightGBM and Chronos challengers
phases.evidence: Actual LightGBM tasks and pinned Chronos inference; 43,964 real-data horizon observations; experimental only.

phases.name: Timestamped feature warehouse and archive import
phases.evidence: Six official SHA-256 verified BTC/ETH archives; causal features and SQLite frozen-input/outcome tests; historical L2 missing.

phases.name: Five-horizon forecasts and frozen outcome grading
phases.evidence: Five horizons, immutable forecasts, full-minute-only grading and missing-window tests.

phases.name: Early watch signals and lead-time measurements
phases.evidence: Quiet-market activity queue and post-move labels verified by tests. Empirical prediction lead-time advantage needs prospective outcomes; no advantage claimed.

phases.name: Purged validation, prospective promotion and rollback
phases.evidence: Purged chronological learning, read-only prospective retraining and matched research suspension verified. No automatic production promotion; prospective cost/performance evidence unavailable.

phases.name: After-cost research and existing risk integration
phases.evidence: Existing execution, exposure and risk regressions preserved. Fixed OHLC research costs and after-cost context implemented; executable new-model EV and profitable paper evidence unverified.

phases.name: Experimental Discord embeds and deduplication
phases.evidence: Experimental embeds, after-cost/uncertainty/source labels and deduplication implemented; payload tests pass. Actual private Discord delivery was not exercised; disabled by default.

phases.name: Authenticated bounded worker and hosting guide
phases.evidence: Authenticated Node-to-Python service and body/response/process limits verified locally. Remote TLS/private transport and cPanel workload support unverified; no deployment.

phases.name: Real-data comparisons and regression/integration checks
phases.evidence: 406 Node tests, 21 Python tests, configured JS/hosting syntax checks; actual LightGBM and pinned Chronos evaluation plus bounded live transport probe. This does not verify future profitability.

phases.name: Publish review branch, evidence and handoff
phases.evidence: Incremental development branch published; PR #1 created. Source audit, setup, machine-readable experiments, live-probe evidence and verified/open checklist committed. Production unchanged.

remaining.reason: Requires newly issued forecasts, later outcomes and verified point-in-time execution costs over enough independent days.
Missing historical multi-provider, execution/event vintages and deployed model artifacts.
Current verified corpus has BTC/ETH only; needs a predeclared point-in-time asset master including inactive/failed symbols.
No evidence justifies selecting or combining the current challengers.
Keep new posting, bridge and production deployment off until reviewed and deliberately configured.

remaining.item: Independent repair of legacy uncertainty/calibration contract
remaining.reason: Baseline reuse of blind data is documented; new pipeline fixes separation without silently changing the old comparison.
